note: A small private park two miles from Mammoth Cave National Park, with a catch-and-release fishing pond, propane and a small RV store. Passport America accepted. --Claude
summary: Kept. $49 (30A) / $55 (50A) re-read on the operator site (undated, © 2026); price gate passes at $49, and it is a Good Sam Park (10%). Full hookups 30/50A, 43 sites, bath house/dump/store/wifi, year-round, phone honor-system reservations. Transient park, no seasonal or monthly rates. Google 4.7/576.
flags: Price gate passes: cheapest electric night $49 (30A full hookup) on the operator home page, read 2026-11-23 (undated rate block); Good Sam Park per the directory (gs: true) would take it to ~$44.
Long-stay tests pass: no weekly, monthly or seasonal rates offered; the operator describes overnight travelers and is 'full nearly every night during tourist season'.
Not waterfront confirmed: sites 15-21 border a small catch-and-release fishing pond (map), not a qualifying water body.
Pin OK (37.1325,-86.02218; Good Sam lists 37.13306,-86.02213). Phone and website unchanged.
